sermons.title: Sermon 616 | The Special Call And The Unfailing Result

scripture.verse: God is faithful, by whom you were called unto the fellowship of His Son Jesus, Christ our Lord.

sermons.title: Sermon 617 | Christ Our Life—Soon To Appear

scripture.verse: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall you also appear with Him in glory.

sermons.title: Sermon 618 | The Great Physician And His Patients

scripture.verse: They that are whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.

sermons.title: Sermon 619 | The Golden Key Of Prayer

scripture.verse: Call unto Me and I will answer you and show you great and mighty things, which you know not.

sermons.title: Sermon 620 | A Warning Against Hardness Of Heart

scripture.verse: But exhort one another daily, while it is called 'Today,'lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

sermons.title: Sermon 621 | The Precious Blood Of Christ
Sermon 622 | Traveling Expenses On The Two Great Roads

scripture.verse: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job.

sermons.title: Sermon 624 | Present Privilege And Future Favor

scripture.verse: The eternal God is your refuge and underneath are the everlasting arms: and He shall thrust out the enemy from before you. And shall say, Destroy them.
